description: Header file defining the OpenMaxComponent class for managing multimedia components, including buffer management, tunneling, and callbacks within the OpenMax framework for Raspberry Pi 4.

classes.name: OpenMaxComponent
classes.description: Class managing OpenMax multimedia components, handling buffer operations, port configuration, and event callbacks.

methods.name: OpenMaxComponent
methods.description: Constructor initializing the component with a name.

methods.name: SetOutputComponent
methods.description: Creates a tunnel to another OpenMaxComponent's output.

methods.name: CloseTunnel
methods.description: Closes all tunnels to output components.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the component processing.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes the component buffers.

methods.name: WriteData
methods.description: Writes data to the input buffer, returns bytes written or -1 on error.

methods.name: WriteEOS
methods.description: Writes an end-of-stream buffer, blocking until available.

methods.name: GetOutputBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves the next output buffer, enabling output port if needed.

methods.name: DropOutputBuffer
methods.description: Releases an output buffer.

methods.name: OnErrorEvent
methods.description: Handles error events.

methods.name: OnEnableInputPort
methods.description: Virtual method to handle input port enabling.

methods.name: OnEnableOutputPort
methods.description: Virtual method to handle output port enabling.

methods.name: ~OpenMaxComponent
methods.description: Destructor for cleanup.

methods.name: AllocateBuffer
methods.description: Allocates buffers for a specified port.

methods.name: DisableOutputPort
methods.description: Disables the output port.

methods.name: EnableInputPortAndAllocateBuffers
methods.description: Enables input port and allocates buffers.

methods.name: EnableOutputPortAndAllocateBuffer
methods.description: Enables output port and allocates buffer.

methods.name: EnableOutputTunnelling
methods.description: Enables tunneling on output port.

methods.name: GetUnusedInputBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves an unused input buffer.

methods.name: OnOutputSettingChanged
methods.description: Handles output setting changes.

methods.name: OnEmptyBufferDone
methods.description: Callback for empty buffer done.

methods.name: OnFillBufferDone
methods.description: Callback for fill buffer done.
